results.title: Dead Lover
results.overview: A lonely gravedigger who stinks of corpses finally meets her dream man, but their whirlwind affair is cut short when he tragically drowns at sea. Grief-stricken, she goes to morbid lengths to resurrect him through madcap scientific experiments, resulting in grave consequences and unlikely love.

results.title: Pulavar
results.overview: A unique retired police officer uses storytelling and his understanding of the human mind to uncover the truth behind crimes committed by criminals who refuse to confess, even after facing beatings and threats.

results.title: Une Fraise
results.overview: Only one strawberry left. Who will get it ?

results.title: Idiotka
results.overview: In West Hollywood’s Russian district, Margarita lives out the American Dream: competing on a reality show. Will she slay, serve, or survive?

results.title: Drop
results.overview: When restless Lisa tries to sneak backstage at a techno festival, a fun night out with her best friend turns into a confrontation with her own psyche.

results.title: Repo! This Movie: The Anatomy of a Cult
results.original_title: Repo! This Movie: The Anatomy of a Cult
results.overview: Featuring insights from director Darren Lynn Bousman and cast members, a look at how the dark, cybergoth rock opera Repo! The Genetic Opera – originating from a modest theatrical stage play – blended industrial goth aesthetics, high-camp operatic numbers, and comic-book gore into an enduring midnight-movie cult classic. The feature-length documentary highlights the grassroots fan movement, shadowcasts, and interactive community gatherings, ala The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

results.title: Hop-Nation
results.overview: In a near-future dystopia set inside 22nd-century's Portugal, a Leader and a Court Jester face off with the future of the new regime at stake. Inspired by Edgar Allan Poe's short-story.

results.title: Ivan
results.overview: Abigail is thrilled when her estranged father reappears, gifting her a cutting-edge AI device named Ivan. However, she soon discovers his sinister plan to use Ivan to control her and her mother, leading to devastating consequences.

results.title: Richard Wagner: Lohengrin @ Baden-Baden Easter Festival 2026
results.overview: Wagner’s sixth opera, “Lohengrin,” tells the medieval legend of the Knight of the Swan: the knight Lohengrin is sent to protect Duchess Elsa of Brabant, who has been unjustly accused of murder. Johannes Erath directs the production, and Joana Mallwitz conducts the orchestra. Piotr Beczała plays the title role. Rachel Willis-Sørensen plays Elsa of Brabant.

results.title: Skintown
results.overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

results.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
results.overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

results.title: The Kindergarten
results.overview: Selim, who moved from Türkiye to France, joins a mandatory workshop with his 4-year-old daughter Defne and notices his drawings are seen as “strange.” Ashamed of his strange drawings, he works day and night but he can’t draw “normal” animals like the others. The more he tries to fit in, the more he fails. Under pressure, his strange drawings turn into hallucinations. In the final week, when Selim gives up, Defne sees his drawing for the first time and says it’s a dinosaur, telling stories about it. Selim realizes that the strangeness he was trying to hide is a source of inspiration for his daughter.

results.title: Human Resource
results.original_title: พนักงานใหม่ (โปรดรับไว้พิจารณา)
results.overview: Working in HR at a challenging company, Fren interviews young new hires and is secretly one month pregnant, grappling with the decision to have a child in difficult circumstances.

results.title: Critical Path
results.overview: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

results.title: The Oligarch and the Art Dealer
results.original_title: The Oligarch and the Art Dealer
results.overview: When the Swiss art dealer Yves Bouvier meets the Russian oligarch Dmitry Rybolovlev, he quickly rises through the ranks. From a role as a discreet adviser, he becomes a global power broker and manager of Rybolovlev’s investments in one of the world’s most closed and enigmatic markets: the part of the art world where the sums are staggering and the value of artworks is something agreed upon by a narrow elite of connoisseurs and ultrarich tycoons. This version edited the 3 episode miniseries down to 2 hours and presented as a feature film.

results.title: Chronovisor
results.overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks.

results.title: Bride of Frankenstein Awakens
results.overview: In a quiet British seaside town, Santana, a troubled young woman desperate to escape her suffocating family, runs away with her volatile boyfriend Frank. The pair marry in a rundown coastal venue, hoping for a fresh start — but their new life is shattered when a mysterious car rams into them on a rural night road, killing Santana instantly and leaving Frank consumed by grief and obsession. Refusing to accept her death, Frank traps his former medical professor, Dr. Pret — a man secretly infatuated with Santana — and forces him to help reanimate her using a stolen voodoo ritual. As Frank’s desperation deepens, he manipulates and blackmails Pret into harvesting “perfect” body parts from Santana’s own family, driving both men further into depravity.

results.title: Swords of Legends: Soul and Blade
results.overview: A fallen immortal's split soul sparks an epic conflict between two vessels of fate, ending in a heroic sacrifice that leaves a grieving lover on a lifelong quest for resurrection.

results.title: Brother Unknown
results.overview: With a dark past in the foster system, a lonely woman questions if her new found half-brother is also the violent stalker wracking havoc on her.
